title: orbvibe
tagline: Real world vibes with real people - attend events with like-minded individuals without worrying if they're real or not.
description:
Have you ever wanted to attend an event but didn’t have anyone to go with… so you didn’t go? Time to put an end to that, whether you just want to go out for a cup of tea or a knitting class, a dance class or more – feel free! Use orbvibe to engage and find real like-minded individuals without worrying if they’re real or not. Only requisite: you need WorldID verification to attend! That’s how we verify you’re human. The plan will be for most of our event partners to be orb operators so you can also verify before the event for access. Current problems are: Privacy. Period! AI is getting more advanced and bypassing captcha's. However, community is key. 

An app that let’s you connect to other like-minded people and attend the coolest vibes. All our event partners are educated on WorldID as a pre-requisite, meaning all members and attendees must be verified with a local orb before they can use the app. 

The app also helps with reducing anxiety of secondary ticket sales for concerts etc as you can ensure the person selling is a real person.
how_its_made: Project created using Next.js, TailwindCSS, and the World ID SDK. Using Worldcoin ID technologies to verify if the potential event attendee you're liaising with is human. Checks that you’re human, takes a picture of each of your iris’, calculates an iris code, then the code is checked for uniqueness, stored in NPC set up, we don’t need name, email, address for the verification. Proof you’re human without revealing your identity. World ID supports multiple "Verification Levels" to prove that a person is a unique human. These levels provide different degrees of humanness assurance, accessibility, and protection against fraud.
